# An if/else whose branches each store the same element becomes one lane-wise
# select: compare, then IfElse. That covers the common activation functions.
# Both branches are computed for every lane, and the results must still match the
# scalar loop for NaN, infinities and signed zeros, which compare the way Go does.

# The scalar program is the reference behavior.
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

cp ops.go ops.go.orig
loopvec -split .
! stdout .
cmpenv stderr stderr.want
cmp ops_simd.go ops_simd.go.want
cmp ops.go ops.go.guarded

# The simd build must behave identically.
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
exec go run ./testmain
cmp stdout testmain/output

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.27.1
-- ops.go --
package test

func ReLU(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func LeakyReLU(dst, x []float32, alpha float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if x[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = x[i]
		} else {
			dst[i] = alpha * x[i]
		}
	}
}

func LeakyReLUInPlace(x []float64, alpha float64) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] *= alpha
		}
	}
}

func ReLU6(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		} else if x[i] > 6 {
			x[i] = 6
		}
	}
}

func HardTanh(x []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < lo {
			x[i] = lo
		} else if x[i] > hi {
			x[i] = hi
		}
	}
}

func Sign(dst, x []float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if x[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = 1
		} else if x[i] < 0 {
			dst[i] = -1
		} else {
			dst[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func Step(dst, x []float32, threshold float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if x[i] >= threshold {
			dst[i] = 1
		} else {
			dst[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func Abs(x []float64) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = -x[i]
		}
	}
}

func ClampInt(x []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < lo {
			x[i] = lo
		} else if x[i] > hi {
			x[i] = hi
		}
	}
}

func Deadband(x []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] > lo && x[i] < hi {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func Replace(x []int32, bad, good int32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] == bad {
			x[i] = good
		}
	}
}

func NaNToZero(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] != x[i] {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}
}
-- ops_simd.go.want --
//go:build goexperiment.simd

package test

import (
	"simd"
	"unsafe"
)

func ReLU(x []float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s0 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcAFloat32s0.IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcAFloat32s0), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func LeakyReLU(dst, x []float32, alpha float32) {
	_vcAFloat32s1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcBFloat32s1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(alpha)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, x) {
		for i := range dst {
			if x[i] > 0 {
				dst[i] = x[i]
			} else {
				dst[i] = alpha * x[i]
			}
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_v1.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcAFloat32s1), _v1.Mul(_vcBFloat32s1)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func LeakyReLUInPlace(x []float64, alpha float64) {
	_vcAFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	_vcBFloat64s2 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(alpha)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(x[_i:])
		_v1.Mul(_vcBFloat64s2).IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcAFloat64s2), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func ReLU6(x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s3_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcFloat32s3_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(6)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcFloat32s3_1.IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcFloat32s3_1), _vcFloat32s3_3.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcFloat32s3_3), _v1)).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func HardTanh(x []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	_vcFloat32s4_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(lo)
	_vcFloat32s4_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(hi)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcFloat32s4_1.IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcFloat32s4_1), _vcFloat32s4_3.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcFloat32s4_3), _v1)).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func Sign(dst, x []float32) {
	_vcFloat32s5_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	_vcFloat32s5_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	_vcFloat32s5_4 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(-1)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, x) {
		for i := range dst {
			if x[i] > 0 {
				dst[i] = 1
			} else if x[i] < 0 {
				dst[i] = -1
			} else {
				dst[i] = 0
			}
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_vcFloat32s5_2.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcFloat32s5_1), _vcFloat32s5_4.IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcFloat32s5_1), _vcFloat32s5_1)).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func Step(dst, x []float32, threshold float32) {
	_vcFloat32s6_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(threshold)
	_vcFloat32s6_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(1)
	_vcFloat32s6_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	if _loopvecOverlap(dst, x) {
		for i := range dst {
			if x[i] >= threshold {
				dst[i] = 1
			} else {
				dst[i] = 0
			}
		}
	} else {
		if len(dst) > 0 {
			_ = x[len(dst)-1]
			for _i := 0; _i < len(dst); {
				_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
				_vcFloat32s6_2.IfElse(_v1.GreaterEqual(_vcFloat32s6_1), _vcFloat32s6_3).StorePart(dst[_i:])
				_i += _n
			}
		}
	}
}

func Abs(x []float64) {
	_vcAFloat64s7 := simd.BroadcastFloat64s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat64sPart(x[_i:])
		_v1.Neg().IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcAFloat64s7), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func ClampInt(x []int32, lo, hi int32) {
	_vcInt32s8_1 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(lo)
	_vcInt32s8_3 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(hi)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcInt32s8_1.IfElse(_v1.Less(_vcInt32s8_1), _vcInt32s8_3.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcInt32s8_3), _v1)).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func Deadband(x []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	_vcFloat32s9_1 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(lo)
	_vcFloat32s9_2 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(hi)
	_vcFloat32s9_3 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcFloat32s9_3.IfElse(_v1.Greater(_vcFloat32s9_1).And(_v1.Less(_vcFloat32s9_2)), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func Replace(x []int32, bad, good int32) {
	_vcAInt32s10 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(bad)
	_vcBInt32s10 := simd.BroadcastInt32s(good)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadInt32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcBInt32s10.IfElse(_v1.Equal(_vcAInt32s10), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func NaNToZero(x []float32) {
	_vcBFloat32s11 := simd.BroadcastFloat32s(0)
	for _i := 0; _i < len(x); {
		_v1, _n := simd.LoadFloat32sPart(x[_i:])
		_vcBFloat32s11.IfElse(_v1.NotEqual(_v1), _v1).StorePart(x[_i:])
		_i += _n
	}
}

func _loopvecOverlap[T any](a, b []T, window ...int) bool {
	aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi := 0, len(a), 0, len(b)
	if len(window) == 4 {
		aLo, aHi, bLo, bHi = window[0], window[1], window[2], window[3]
	}
	if aLo >= aHi || bLo >= bHi {
		return false
	}
	size := unsafe.Sizeof(a[0])
	aBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(a)))
	bBase := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(unsafe.SliceData(b)))
	aStart, aEnd := aBase+uintptr(aLo)*size, aBase+uintptr(aHi)*size
	bStart, bEnd := bBase+uintptr(bLo)*size, bBase+uintptr(bHi)*size
	return aStart < bEnd && bStart < aEnd
}

func ReLU(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func LeakyReLU(dst, x []float32, alpha float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if x[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = x[i]
		} else {
			dst[i] = alpha * x[i]
		}
	}
}

func LeakyReLUInPlace(x []float64, alpha float64) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] *= alpha
		}
	}
}

func ReLU6(x []float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = 0
		} else if x[i] > 6 {
			x[i] = 6
		}
	}
}

func HardTanh(x []float32, lo, hi float32) {
	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < lo {
			x[i] = lo
		} else if x[i] > hi {
			x[i] = hi
		}
	}
}

		if x[i] > 0 {
			dst[i] = 1
		} else if x[i] < 0 {
			dst[i] = -1
		} else {
			dst[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

func Step(dst, x []float32, threshold float32) {
	for i := range dst {
		if x[i] >= threshold {
			dst[i] = 1
		} else {
			dst[i] = 0
		}
	}
}

	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < 0 {
			x[i] = -x[i]
		}
	}
}

	for i := range x {
		if x[i] < lo {
			x[i] = lo
		} else if x[i] > hi {
			x[i] = hi
		}
	}
}

	for i := range x {
		if x[i] > lo && x[i] < hi {
			x[i] = 0
		}
	}

-- testmain/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"math"

	"example.com/test"
)

var sizes = []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 9, 16, 17, 33, 64, 65, 100, 131}

// special values cycle through the float inputs so every lane count meets NaN,
// infinities, and both zeros.
var special = []float32{
	float32(math.NaN()), float32(math.Inf(1)), float32(math.Inf(-1)),
	0, float32(math.Copysign(0, -1)), -1, 1, 6, -6, 6.5, -0.5, 3.25, 100, -100,
}

func floats32(n int) []float32 {
	s := make([]float32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = special[(i*7+n)%len(special)]
	}
	return s
}

func floats64(n int) []float64 {
	s := make([]float64, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = float64(special[(i*5+n)%len(special)])
	}
	return s
}

func ints(n int) []int32 {
	s := make([]int32, n)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = int32((i*37+n)%23) - 11
	}
	return s
}

// bits makes the output comparable: NaN compares unequal to itself and -0 equals 0.
func bits32(s []float32) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + uint64(math.Float32bits(v))
	}
	return h
}

func bits64(s []float64) (h uint64) {
	for _, v := range s {
		h = h*1099511628211 + math.Float64bits(v)
	}
	return h
}

func sum(s []int32) (t int64) {
	for i, v := range s {
		t += int64(v) * int64(i+1)
	}
	return t
}

func main() {
	for _, n := range sizes {
		x := floats32(n)
		test.ReLU(x)
		fmt.Println(n, "ReLU", bits32(x))

		dst := make([]float32, n)
		test.LeakyReLU(dst, floats32(n), 0.125)
		fmt.Println(n, "LeakyReLU", bits32(dst))

		f := floats64(n)
		test.LeakyReLUInPlace(f, 0.01)
		fmt.Println(n, "LeakyReLUInPlace", bits64(f))

		x = floats32(n)
		test.ReLU6(x)
		fmt.Println(n, "ReLU6", bits32(x))

		x = floats32(n)
		test.HardTanh(x, -1.5, 2.5)
		fmt.Println(n, "HardTanh", bits32(x))

		test.Sign(dst, floats32(n))
		fmt.Println(n, "Sign", bits32(dst))

		test.Step(dst, floats32(n), 1)
		fmt.Println(n, "Step", bits32(dst))

		f = floats64(n)
		test.Abs(f)
		fmt.Println(n, "Abs", bits64(f))

		i := ints(n)
		test.ClampInt(i, -4, 5)
		fmt.Println(n, "ClampInt", sum(i))

		x = floats32(n)
		test.Deadband(x, -2, 2)
		fmt.Println(n, "Deadband", bits32(x))

		i = ints(n)
		test.Replace(i, 3, 99)
		fmt.Println(n, "Replace", sum(i))

		x = floats32(n)
		test.NaNToZero(x)
		fmt.Println(n, "NaNToZero", bits32(x))
	}
}
